import json
import datetime

# Get input data
items = items or []
if not items:
    return [{"json": {"error": "No data received"}}]

commits = items[0].get('json', items[0])
issues = items[1].get('json', items[1]) if len(items) > 1 else []
prs = items[2].get('json', items[2]) if len(items) > 2 else []

# Clean data
if isinstance(issues, dict) and 'json' in issues:
    issues = issues['json']
if isinstance(prs, dict) and 'json' in prs:
    prs = prs['json']
if isinstance(commits, dict) and 'json' in commits:
    commits = commits['json']

# Ensure lists
if not isinstance(commits, list): commits = [commits] if commits else []
if not isinstance(issues, list): issues = [issues] if issues else []
if not isinstance(prs, list): prs = [prs] if prs else []

# Filter: only closed issues (not PRs that show up as issues)
closed_issues = [i for i in issues if i.get('pull_request') is None]
merged_prs = [p for p in prs if p.get('merged_at') is not None]

# Format commits
commit_lines = []
for c in commits[:20]:
    msg = c.get('commit',{}).get('message','').split('\n')[0][:100]
    author = c.get('commit',{}).get('author',{}).get('name','Unknown')
    date = c.get('commit',{}).get('author',{}).get('date','')[:10]
    commit_lines.append(f"- {date} | {author}: {msg}")

# Format issues
issue_lines = []
for i in closed_issues[:15]:
    issue_lines.append(f"- #{i.get('number')} {i.get('title')}")

# Format PRs
pr_lines = []
for p in merged_prs[:15]:
    pr_lines.append(f"- #{p.get('number')} {p.get('title')} by {p.get('user',{}).get('login','Unknown')}")

context = {
    "commits_text": "\n".join(commit_lines),
    "issues_text": "\n".join(issue_lines),
    "prs_text": "\n".join(pr_lines),
    "commit_count": len(commits),
    "issue_count": len(closed_issues),
    "pr_count": len(merged_prs),
    "repo_name": items[0].get('owner','unknown') + '/' + items[0].get('repo','unknown'),
    "week_start": (datetime.datetime.now() - datetime.timedelta(days=7)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
    "week_end": datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
}

return [{"json": context}]
